crossrefs.text: Then Jesus said to Thomas, “Put your finger here and look at My hands. Reach out your hand and put it into My side. Stop doubting and believe.”
For we cannot stop speaking about what we have seen and heard.”
God, who has called you into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord, is faithful.
And we have seen and testify that the Father has sent His Son to be the Savior of the world.
In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is Himself God and is at the Fatherʼs side, has made Him known.
I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.

And we know that the Son of God has come and has given us understanding, so that we may know Him who is true; and we are in Him who is true—in His Son Jesus Christ. He is the true God and eternal life.
For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
Once again, Jesus spoke to the people and said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows Me will never walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”
Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn from the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To Him who loves us and has released us from our sins by His blood,
No longer will the sun be your light by day, nor the brightness of the moon shine on your night; for the LORD will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your splendor.
The LORD is my light and my salvation— whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life— whom shall I dread?
The night is nearly over; the day has drawn near. So let us lay aside the deeds of darkness and put on the armor of light.
In Him we have redemption through His blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of His grace
Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
He who conceals his sins will not prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them will find mercy.
And I will cleanse them from all the iniquity they have committed against Me, and will forgive all their sins of rebellion against Me.
Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
Surely I was brought forth in iniquity; I was sinful when my mother conceived me.
But if we walk in the light as He is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus His Son cleanses us from all sin.
for all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God,
We all stumble in many ways. If anyone is never at fault in what he says, he is a perfect man, able to control his whole body.
